summaryJa: 33 SOS発のISR任務（機体/コールサインは秘匿）はLGLRから離陸（DTG 281504Z OCT23）し、オンステーションは281018Z OCT23到着、290542Z OCT23離脱で総ミッション時間20時間01分、オンステーション時間9時間24分。主センサーはFMV（補助にG‑MESH）、任務はターゲット開発/監視で、指定点（座標は秘匿）でFMV/SIGINT収集を実施。到着後は2019Z–2243Zに複数の関連COIをポーリングしたがEEIは観測されず、2244Zに駐車場屋上で車両6台を確認、人員は確認されなかった。FMVはGETにより解析され、任務は“Intel Gap Filled: Yes / Satisfactory”。UAP事象はDTG 290811Z OCT23に発生。RIB搭乗者が海面上すぐを飛行する小型でほぼ円形の物体を視認し陸側へ飛行、同時刻に映像フィードで追跡不能となった。報告上の評価は「良性（Benign）」、物理状態は“固体”、推進方式は不明、推定速度30 MPH、センサー署名や機材への影響は記載なし。
summaryEn: An ISR sortie originating from 33 SOS (aircraft/callsign masked) departed LGLR (DTG 281504Z OCT23). On-station from 282018Z OCT23 to 290542Z OCT23; total mission time 20:01, on-station time 9:24. Primary sensor was FMV (with G‑MESH available); tasked for target development/collection at a masked start point where FMV/SIGINT collection was conducted. From 2019Z–2243Z the crew polled several associated COIs with no EEI observed; at 2244Z they observed six vehicles on a parking‑garage rooftop with no personnel. FMV was exploited by GET; effectiveness noted as “Intel Gap Filled: Yes / Satisfactory.” A UAP event occurred at 290811Z OCT23: RIB personnel observed a small, seemingly circular object flying just above the ocean toward land and it was lost from the feed at the same time. Reported assessment: benign; physical state solid; propulsion unknown; estimated kinetic velocity 30 MPH; no signatures or effects on equipment reported. Tasking details and many identifiers are masked.
